baseline_models.focus_anchor: The transitive يَأْكُلُهُ is closed by the negation-exception construction إِلَّا ٱلْخَاطِـُٔونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah first presents a one-way act of bodily intake, then uses the exception to make deliberate wrongdoers the exhaustive eater class.

activation_trace.role: Bodily ingestion supplies the direct action, while the exception restricts who can perform it.
Culpable wrongdoing makes the exclusive consumers morally answerable actors, not a neutral demographic.

changed_reading.before: An unnamed object is eaten by an unspecified group.
changed_reading.after: The object is literally ingested, and deliberate wrongdoers are marked as its sole consumer class.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَأْكُلُهُ can activate the provision or consumable-share branch, and إِلَّا reserves it to one class.
baseline_models.mechanism: Eating is not only a mouth action: it can be receipt of an allotted provision. The exception then behaves like an allocation rule assigning this share only to culpable recipients, while the focus alone leaves its pleasant or punitive quality open.

activation_trace.role: The consumable-share image turns the object into an assigned portion rather than merely generic food.
The culpable class supplies the criterion by which that portion is reserved.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports an isolated act of eating.
changed_reading.after: The clause distributes a consumable share exclusively to a morally marked class.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْخَاطِـُٔونَ can retain the spatial image of passing beyond or failing to hit what is right.
baseline_models.mechanism: The eater label becomes a trajectory rather than only a fixed moral noun: people whose action missed the proper endpoint uniquely arrive at this consumable endpoint. Intentional guilt remains a coexisting branch rather than being erased.

activation_trace.role: Missing or passing beyond the right direction supplies the trajectory that terminates at the food.
Ingestion supplies the new endpoint reached by the misdirected actors.

changed_reading.before: The final noun is a static label for bad people.
changed_reading.after: The consumers are agents whose prior direction overshot the right target and landed at this act of intake.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb carries both ordinary consumption and the branch of being eaten away or decaying.
baseline_models.mechanism: Although the syntax points from eater to object, the erosion branch makes the material relation potentially reciprocal: taking this object inward may be the means by which it eats away the eater.

activation_trace.role: Erosion and decay reverse pressure back onto the consumer, making ingestion materially self-destructive.
Culpable agency keeps the reciprocal damage attached to the focus eater class.

changed_reading.before: The eaters act on a passive object.
changed_reading.after: The sole eaters enter reciprocal consumption: they ingest the substance and are eaten away through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus joins the yield branch of eating to the rain-missed-land branch of error. Context supplies hollow palms, overflowing water, near fruit, and food heard through ripening: together they activate a failed moral ecology in which the wrongdoer's portion is an anti-harvest rather than ordinary nourishment.

activation_trace.role: Fruit or crop yield lets the focus food function as a harvest.
Land missed by rain supplies the ecological form of failure attached to the eater class.
The palm-tree image supplies the crop body that can stand either fruitful or ruined.
Emptiness turns the fallen palms into a failed-yield image rather than living provision.
The repeated root reactivates the physical image of a tract bypassed by rain inside the narrated offense.
Overflowing water supplies the opposite imbalance: water exceeds its limit rather than reaching land as measured provision.
Pickable fruit supplies the successful harvest against which the focus portion can be heard as failed yield.
Ripening and taking flavor lets the immediately preceding food participate in the harvest contrast.

structural_cues: The context moves from emptied palms and excessive water to accessible fruit and then to the sole food immediately before 69:37.
The focus itself couples the yield-capable eating root with a root whose inventory includes land bypassed by rain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the crop, water, fruit, food, and missed-rain images; I infer that their sequence forms a moral harvest and that the focus portion is its failed crop. A live alternative is that these remain separate destruction, garden, and punishment scenes.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoers alone receive an unspecified consumable share.
changed_reading.after: Their exclusive food can be carried as a sterile or misgrown yield: the harvest reached by those who missed the right course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated error root is followed by explicit departure from obedience and seizure for guilt. This sequence selects deliberate culpability as the dominant identification of the focus eaters while retaining the missed-course image as a secondary account of how they arrived there.

activation_trace.role: Literal ingestion remains the consequence assigned to the class clarified by context.
Missing the right course preserves the baseline ambiguity that context revises.
Intentional wrongdoing supplies the culpable reading strengthened by the narrated sequence.
The cognate occurrence carries sin and guilt into the context before the focus class reappears.
Exit from obedience makes the contextual offense volitional rather than accidental.
Being taken to account for guilt supplies the juridical consequence linking culpability to the focus allocation.

structural_cues: 69:9 repeats the focus root before 69:10 moves from disobedience to punitive taking.
The focus active participle names a durable actor class after context has narrated accountable acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root repetition, disobedience, and seizure for guilt; I infer that this chain disambiguates the focus class toward intentional culpability. The live alternative is that the earlier cognate names an event while the focus noun independently includes both error and sin.

changed_reading.before: The consumers could be heard broadly as people who merely missed the right result.
changed_reading.after: They are primarily intentional transgressors whose exclusive intake is matched to accountable disobedience, with misdirection retained as its trajectory image.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context establishes a beneficial mode of taking inward: an accepting ear lets a reminder be contained in the heart as in a vessel and become protective. Against that channel, the focus mouth performs a grotesque anti-reception, incorporating harmful material where warning was not inwardly retained.

activation_trace.role: Eating supplies bodily inward transfer as the punitive counterpart to attentive reception.
The vessel or source of eating gives the mouth-body channel a container structure.
The reminder supplies the beneficial content available for inward reception.
Containing meaning in the heart supplies the cognitive form of incorporation.
Containing a thing in a vessel makes the inward-reception analogy materially explicit.
Attentive acceptance supplies the open sensory gate through which the beneficial content should enter.
Making the self a protective enclosure supplies the result of receiving the reminder well.

structural_cues: 69:12 and 69:37 both use a pronoun-bearing verb for taking an object inward, but through different bodily channels.
The reminder returns in 69:48 for the protected class, while the focus assigns ingestion to the culpable class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, accepting ear, heart-container, vessel, protection, and eating; I infer an antithesis between inwardly holding warning and inwardly taking punishment. A live alternative is that hearing and eating are independent scenes without a channel substitution.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes only a punitive meal.
changed_reading.after: The meal also acts as failed reception made bodily: what was not held inwardly as warning is replaced by harmful inward intake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden scene presents pickable fruit and pleasant eating explicitly because of what was sent ahead. It therefore turns the focus provision into the negative member of a recompense pair: each class consumes a matured return of prior action.

activation_trace.role: Yield allows the focus object to be read as the crop of antecedent conduct.
Consumable provision makes the focus meal an allotted return.
Picked fruit supplies the positive, matured yield in the paired meal architecture.
The contextual eating command realizes provision as something actually received and consumed.
Ease without harm marks the positive meal, sharpening the inverse quality of the focus meal.
Prior advance supplies the explicit temporal arrow from earlier action to later consumption.

structural_cues: The right-hand and left-hand scenes form contrasting allocations after records are received.
The positive command to eat states its causal ground, while 69:36-37 closes the negative scene with food and its exclusive eaters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a pleasant meal causally tied to prior action and an exclusive meal for the culpable class; I infer that the explicit positive causality governs the negative parallel as well. A live alternative is that only the positive meal is framed as harvested recompense.

changed_reading.before: The focus reserves an isolated consumable share to wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: That share is the negative edible yield of what its consumers sent ahead, paired with the pleasant harvest of the other class.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, commands make the condemned person the grammatical object of capture, shackling, exposure to fire, and insertion into a chain. The focus then makes the culpable class the active subject of eating, so its agency is real but radically constrained: ingestion is the inward stage of an imposed punitive process.

activation_trace.role: Active bodily ingestion supplies the agency that the preceding object-processing sequence constrains.
Capture and arrest begin the imposed handling of the eventual eater.
A collar that binds the limb removes ordinary freedom of movement and choice.
Encountering the fire places the body inside the punitive material environment.
Insertion of one thing into another supplies the coercive inward-processing pattern that eating then reverses into intake.

structural_cues: 69:30-32 repeatedly addresses an external agent and treats the condemned person as the object of imperatives.
69:37 abruptly restores an active plural eater after that object sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capture, binding, fire, insertion, and then active eating; I infer that the preceding constraints alter the practical agency of the focus verb. A live alternative is that the active form insists on willing participation despite the surrounding coercion.

changed_reading.before: Eating suggests an eater voluntarily taking available food.
changed_reading.after: The active eating occurs inside captivity and functions as the final inward phase of an externally imposed punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusation is social failure to urge feeding another; the consequence immediately removes ordinary food, names a washing-associated anti-food, and restricts its eating to the culpable. The focus thus completes a reversal from refusing circulation of nourishment to receiving an isolating, harmful provision.

activation_trace.role: The consumable-share image makes the focus object the replacement provision assigned after social nourishment was withheld.
Culpability attaches the returned provision to accountable social failure.
Urging action supplies the omitted social impulse that should have moved food toward another person.
Feeding another makes the denied duty relational rather than merely a private failure to eat.
Tasting and taking food supplies the narrowed consequence that answers the omitted feeding.
Washing by flowing away dirt gives the named sole food an anti-nourishing image of scouring and removal.

structural_cues: 69:34-37 is an uninterrupted progression from failure to feed, to no ordinary food, to the sole food, to its sole eaters.
The two exclusive constructions in 69:36-37 narrow both available food and eligible consumer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an omitted duty of feeding followed immediately by restricted food and restricted eaters; I infer a reciprocal reversal between the social act withheld and the provision received. A live alternative is that the accusation and food punishment are adjacent but not measure-for-measure.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoers happen to be the only consumers of a punitive ration.
changed_reading.after: Their exclusive anti-food returns the nourishment they refused to help circulate: withheld feeding becomes isolating intake.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branches distinguish a true protective enclosure, the stripping of cover, and the covering of truth. Read back into eating, the culpable consumers chose epistemic covering but lack effective shielding; the harmful provision crosses the bodily boundary they cannot preserve.

activation_trace.role: Ingestion is a boundary crossing that carries the harmful object from outside to inside.
The eating vessel gives that outside-inside boundary a concrete container form.
Protection that repels harm supplies the successful boundary unavailable to the focus eaters.
Placing the self inside a shield supplies the intact alternative to harmful incorporation.
Removal of a covering activates exposure beneath the contextual regret.
Being bare of protection makes the failure of the eater's boundary explicit.
Covering the truth supplies the ineffective epistemic cover exchanged for bodily exposure.

structural_cues: 69:48 and 69:50 place protected people and covering people in opposed response classes.
Eating in 69:37 is the most concrete crossing of an outside-inside boundary in the local sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, self-enclosure, uncovering, truth-covering, and ingestion; I infer a permeability reversal in which false covering fails to keep harm outside. A live alternative is that these roots remain moral and affective labels without a shared boundary mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The eater class is defined only by wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: It is also the class whose chosen cover fails as protection, leaving harmful provision able to pass inward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited eating branch normally places prey or a designated animal on the eaten side, while 69:37 grammatically makes wrongdoers the eaters. It remains live because the focus word carries that branch and 69:30-32 repeatedly processes the same condemned figure as an object. Render only as an eater/prey role oscillation or material analogy, never as a replacement translation of the active verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَأْكُلُهُ anchors the eater role, while its designated-prey branch permits pressure in the opposite direction.

activation_trace.role: Prey or livestock set aside for eating introduces the role that unexpectedly rebounds onto the designated consumer.
Culpability keeps the role reversal attached to the named focus class.
Capture makes the future eater an object in another agent's hands.
Being brought into fire continues the treatment of the eater as processed material.
Insertion into another thing completes the object-role that coexists uneasily with active eating.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoers are simply subjects who consume a passive object.
changed_reading.after: The punishment makes the designated consumer resemble designated prey: the eater consumes while being captured, processed, and inserted as an object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus syntax does not make fire the eater. It remains anchored in the focus eating root's fire-feeding image and in the immediately preceding fiery environment. Downstream prose should frame it as a material circuit in which the sinner's intake sustains the process consuming the sinner, not as the lexical sense of يَأْكُلُهُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fire-feeding branch of يَأْكُلُهُ is activated while the focus still retains its ordinary human subject.

activation_trace.role: Feeding fire and blazing turns consumption into fuel transfer as well as bodily intake.
Blazing heat supplies the consuming environment into which the eater has been placed.
Kindling and fire-processing supply the material transformation fed by the focus intake.
Heat and severity attached to the named food link what enters the eater to the surrounding blaze.

changed_reading.before: The sinner eats food while fire is a separate punishment.
changed_reading.after: Eating and burning form a circuit: the severe intake feeds the fiery process that is consuming the eater.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because the ordinary syntax is physical eating, whereas the cited branch extends eating into imputing liability or handing someone over. It remains unusually well activated by the later sequence of fabricated attribution, seizure for guilt, and absence of any barrier. Render it as a juridical undertone beneath literal ingestion, not as a denial that eating occurs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The liability-or-handover branch belongs directly to the focus verb, and the exclusive culpable class supplies the party made answerable.

activation_trace.role: Imputing an act or handing someone over turns the eating relation into assignment of liability.
Culpable wrongdoing supplies the legal basis for that handover.
Saying or attributing what did not occur supplies the hypothetical act that creates liability.
Seizure for guilt supplies the consequence of being made answerable.
The absence of an intervening barrier makes the handover to consequence irreversible.

changed_reading.before: The exception only identifies who physically eats.
changed_reading.after: Beneath physical ingestion, the exception also sounds like a liability rule: culpability hands this class over to the thing assigned to them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This depends on the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the focus eating root to ك ل ل, so it is morphologically distant and must not control translation. It remains valid as an experiment-visible resonance because the mapping is supplied rather than invented and later force-depletion activates it. Render only as an anti-nutritive undertone: this eating completes weariness instead of restoring strength.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapped inventory attached to focus word 2 supplies weariness and loss of sharpness.

activation_trace.role: Weariness and dulling reverse the normal nutritive expectation of eating.
Force cut off and exhausted supplies the contextual endpoint of the anti-nutritive process.

changed_reading.before: Even punitive eating is structurally an act that might sustain an eater.
changed_reading.after: The act is anti-nutrition: consuming the assigned food completes dulling and exhaustion rather than replenishing force.

strongest_changes: The positive garden meal turns the focus food into the negative edible yield of prior action rather than an isolated ration.
Failure to move food toward the needy returns as a narrowed anti-food relation whose provision and consumers are both exclusive.
Capture, binding, fire, and insertion constrain the active eating, while attentive ear-heart reception supplies a coexisting anti-reception model.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several mechanisms at once: juridical allocation, moral harvest, social reversal, channel substitution, bodily permeability, and reciprocal material damage. The packet's stranger branches also preserve eater/prey oscillation, fire fueling, liability transfer, and exhaustion without forcing them into the main reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus-only pronoun leaves the object's identity open; 69:36 resolves its immediate discourse source, but several material branch activations remain analogical.
The active verb resists a literal force-feeding or eater/prey reversal even though the preceding captive-processing sequence strongly constrains agency.
The exhaustion reading relies on a supplied but non-dominant split mapping and should remain explicitly form-distant.
